stem.text: Enzymes are biological catalysts. Many enzymes show specificity. An example of an enzyme which shows specificity is glucokinase. Glucokinase is involved in the metabolism of glucose.
What does specificity mean in this context?

A.text: Glucokinase is most effective as a catalyst over a narrow pH range.

B.text: Glucokinase is most effective as a catalyst over a narrow range of temperatures.

C.text: Glucokinase only operates on a narrow range of substrate molecules.

D.text: Glucokinase provides an alternative route for the reactions it catalyses.
